long_description:
This Tantra Vidya training brings the best tools and practices to give you a firm foundation in Tantric Hatha Yoga. Explore yoga asana, pranayama, mudra, bandha, meditation and more. Especially supportive in our modern times, Tantra offers reprieve from today’s problems and challenges as it helps free the mind with its thriving, sustainable worldview to evolve beyond our suffering.

Learn more, including how to sign up, here: https://devanadiyoga.com/training/tantra-vidya-part-1-foundations-of-tantric-hatha-yoga/
